subject: MAP: SOC 2 package — draft deliverables & owners
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 package — draft deliverables & owners

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached so your team can review. Key MAP milestone we're tracking now: Security review / SOC 2 package delivery.

High-level items I captured for that milestone: 
- SOC 2 questionnaire (completed by Redwood) — owner: Redwood (Sergio) — target: 2026-10-07
- Evidence inventory (template provided) — owner: Acme (Jamie) — target: 2026-10-12
- Artifact collection (logs, config screenshots, policy docs) — split ownership, see draft spreadsheet
- Security contact review & follow-up call — owner: Acme Security (security@acme.com) — requested week of 10/12

Attached: redwood-map-soc2-draft.xlsx; soc2-questionnaire_v1.docx; evidence-inventory-template.csv

Next steps for us: 
1) Alex / Jamie — confirm the Acme evidence owner(s) and realistic ETA for the inventory (I put 10/12 as a placeholder).
2) Marissa / Priyom — can you validate the questionnaire answers we’ll provide (technical and infra sections) and flag any gaps?
3) I’ll schedule a 30-minute technical handoff with your security team; proposed slots in the MAP.

If this looks good I’ll update the MAP with confirmed owners and ship version 2.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- redwood-map-soc2-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- soc2-questionnaire_v1.docx (docx)

From: Alex Li <alex.li@acme.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Tran <jamie.tran@acme.com>, Acme IT Security <security@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 package — draft deliverables & owners

Thanks, Sergio. Appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Jamie will own the evidence inventory and can start populating the template; she is OOO next week but can begin by 10/11 and target a working draft by 10/15.
- Our security team (security@acme.com) wants to review the questionnaire before you finalize. Can you share the completed questionnaire separately?
- We will need specific artifact examples — e.g., nginx access logs, kubelet audit logs, IAM policy screenshots — so the evidence-inventory template is helpful.

Regarding the initial dates: 10/7 for your questionnaire might be tight given internal alignment, can we push that to 10/10? If Redwood can deliver the questionnaire by 10/10, we’ll aim to have a first-pass inventory by 10/15 and a security review meeting during the week of 10/19.

Also looping in Jamie and security. Jamie — confirm if 10/15 is workable for a draft.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product — Acme Robotics
alex.li@acme.com

On Sat, Oct 3, 2026 at 09:12 AM sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached so your team can review.

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: SOC 2 package — draft deliverables & owners (internal)

Sergio — quick internal note after reading Alex's reply: 

1) Questionnaire timeline: we can realistically complete the technical sections by EOD 10/09 if we divvy up ownership. I suggest: 
   - Infra & ops: Dev Patel (dev.patel) — screenshots, logging endpoints, retention windows
   - App controls & change mgmt: Priyom — release cadence, PR review policies, RBAC mapping
   - Data handling & encryption: Marissa — KMS/HSM, key rotation notes, data-at-rest/encryption details

2) Evidence list: attach the evidence-inventory-template.csv and start pre-filling Redwood-owned artifacts so Acme sees examples. I’ll start populating with the following artifacts we can provide quickly:
   - SOC2_Access_Control_List.pdf (roles & permissions export)
   - logging-sample-20260930.tar.gz (log excerpt stub)

3) Proposed MAP update: change sergio's questionnaire target to 2026-10-10 per Alex, and set Acme inventory draft to 2026-10-15. Set security review meeting week of 2026-10-19.

I’ll prepare a version 2 of the questionnaire with redwood sections filled and share here for quick review before sending to Acme security.

— Priyom
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- evidence-inventory-template.csv (CSV)

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@acme.com>
Cc: Jamie Tran <jamie.tran@acme.com>, Acme IT Security <security@acme.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Updated MAP v2 — SOC 2 deliverables, owners, and proposed timeline

Alex / Jamie / Acme security — attaching MAP v2 and a filled draft of the SOC 2 questionnaire for your review. Per our internal alignment we adjusted a couple dates: 

Key updates (MAP v2):
- Redwood SOC 2 questionnaire: owner: Sergio — new target 2026-10-10 (attached: soc2-questionnaire_v1.docx — Redwood sections filled)
- Evidence inventory: owner: Jamie (Acme) — target: 2026-10-15 (we’ve provided a pre-filled example in the attached CSV)
- Artifact deliverables: split view in the spreadsheet; Redwood-fast-turn items marked in column B
- Security review call: proposed 2026-10-20 14:00 PT — please confirm availability; meeting invite to follow once confirmed

Attachments included: redwood-map-soc2-draft.xlsx (MAP v2), soc2-questionnaire_v1.docx (Redwood sections completed), evidence-inventory-template.csv (pre-filled examples)

Callouts / asks for Acme:
- Please confirm Jamie as primary evidence owner and if someone else should be added to the MAP (e.g., infra ops contact).
- Any specific artifact formats that your auditors expect? We can export logs in CSV or compressed tar.

If no objections I’ll mark MAP v2 as official and open the meeting scheduling. Thanks all — we’re aiming for a streamlined exchange so your audit window stays comfortable.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
